name: zamua
description: Zamua's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram forum-topic agent router: multiplex one bot token across concurrent Claude Code conversations, plus opt-in harness-locked Google Antigravity topics in persistent Herdr sessions with dynamic subscription model and effort selection.

plugins.name: pr-review-board
plugins.description: React to a pull request with an emoji and a background Claude reviews it: a local poller spawns one review agent per changeset in its own herdr workspace, which writes the review to a board drawn beside it in the board plugin's review view, a plain-English report linked to the code it calls out and the numbered comments it proposes. It posts only the ones you pick. Approves only when you say so, never pushes.

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: One pane beside the chat holding every board, with a row of buttons to switch between them: the session board Claude keeps current, the pull requests this session raised with GitHub's live state, the pr-review-board review this session runs, one tree of everything you work on from your goals down to the sessions and pull requests doing it, where a root session starts and coordinates the others and sees every ask waiting on you and every session's pull requests and reviews in a tab per section, and any board another process writes as JSON, such as a rollout, named in ~/.config/board/boards.json. Each button shows how many items wait on you. /board toggles the pane, /board <name> opens it on one board.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review code in layers, starting with ownership and approach, then system design, implementation and the existing fourteen clean-code smells. Use before or during implementation, for diff and PR reviews, and for codebase audits.

plugins.name: clean-copy
plugins.description: Cut interface copy that shouldn't exist: captions that restate a label, hints that pre-empt a worry the user never had, warnings left over from a fixed bug. Use when writing or reviewing any user-facing string, or when asked to tighten copy.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Current web platform best practices for HTML, CSS and client-side JavaScript, by Google Chrome.
